source: PR78 k_ij for the pairs that involve an imported compound (owner decision D3): DWSIM 10.2.5 kij_pr.dat; else the DECHEMA Peng-Robinson value of ChemSep pr_ip.dat (Kooijman and Taylor, Artistic License 2.0) whose fitted temperature range is nearest 300..600 K; else no pair (the method's zero). Owner exceptions (tools/compound-import/pair-exceptions.json): no Hydrogen pair; Methane/HydrogenSulfide from ChemSep pr.ipd 2009. Pairs between existing compounds are left to their own libraries.
